mcqs.question:
How many of the following figures correctly describe Aichi–Nagoya 2026?
1. 43 sports
2. 71 disciplines
3. 469 events
4. 54 venues
mcqs.explanation: All four figures are correct: 43 sports, 71 disciplines, 469 events and 54 venues. Therefore, the correct response is All four.

mcqs.question: What was the official slogan of the 20th Asian Games Aichi–Nagoya 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The official slogan was “Imagine One Asia.” “Harmonic Heart Beat” was the theme of the opening ceremony, not the Games slogan.

mcqs.question: Which mascot represented the 20th Asian Games?
mcqs.explanation: HONOHON was the mascot of the Games. Its design represented a rising flame and included Shachihoko ears and Kumadori eyes inspired by Kabuki.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The 20th Asian Games were declared open at Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium in Nagoya.
Reason (R): The opening ceremony was held on 19 September and had the theme “Harmonic Heart Beat”.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true: the opening took place at Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium in Nagoya on 19 September, with the theme “Harmonic Heart Beat”. The theme describes the ceremony but does not explain why the stadium was the venue.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding Aichi–Nagoya 2026.

List-I
 a. Opening flag-bearer pair for India
 b. Cauldron lighters
 c. Closing flag-bearer
 d. Host of the 21st Asian Games

List-II
 i. Neeru Dhanda
 ii. Doha, Qatar
 iii. Manu Bhaker and Pawan Sehrawat
 iv. Shigenobu Murofushi and Koji Murofushi
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iii, b-iv, c-i and d-ii. Manu Bhaker and Pawan Sehrawat carried India’s opening flag, the Murofushi pair lit the cauldron, Neeru Dhanda carried the closing flag, and Doha will host the 21st edition.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding sports introduced or included as new features at Aichi–Nagoya 2026 is incorrect?
options: MMA was included for the first time.
Padel was among the new sports.
Surfing was excluded from the Games.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that surfing was excluded; surfing was among the sports listed along with skateboarding, sport climbing and esports. Teqball debuted, MMA appeared for the first time, and Padel was also included.

mcqs.question: Which country topped the medal table at the 20th Asian Games?
mcqs.explanation: China topped the medal table with 341 medals and continued its run of topping the Asian Games for the 12th consecutive edition. Japan, South Korea and India occupied the next three positions respectively.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: India finished 4th at both Hangzhou 2023 and Aichi–Nagoya 2026.
Statement B: India won 28 gold medals at Aichi–Nagoya 2026.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is true because India finished 4th at both editions. Statement B is false: India won 21 gold medals at Aichi–Nagoya 2026, while 28 gold medals were recorded for Hangzhou 2023.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I
 a. Cricket
 b. Kabaddi
 c. Golf
 d. Wrestling

List-II
 i. Six medals, the best Indian performance since 1962 Jakarta
 ii. India’s first golf gold
 iii. Double gold, with the women defeating Sri Lanka and the men defeating Pakistan
 iv. Double gold, with both Indian teams defeating Iran
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iii, b-iv, c-ii and d-i. Cricket produced double gold against Sri Lanka and Pakistan, kabaddi produced double gold against Iran, Pranavi Urs won India’s first golf gold, and wrestling won six medals.

mcqs.question: Who became the first recipient of the Jaspal Rana Award for the best female athlete at the Asian Games?
mcqs.explanation: Kumkum Anil Mohod became the first recipient of the Jaspal Rana Award for the best female athlete. Neeru Dhanda was the closing flag-bearer, Lovlina Borgohain won boxing gold, and Pranavi Urs won India’s first golf gold.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): India’s men’s and women’s hockey teams won gold medals at the same Asian Games.
Reason (R): Both teams qualified for the LA 2028 Games.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true: India’s women defeated China 1–0 and the men defeated Malaysia 5–1, making it the first time both won hockey gold in the same Games. Their qualification for LA 2028 is a related outcome, but it does not explain the occurrence of the double hockey gold.

mcqs.question: Who was the President of the Olympic Council of Asia during Aichi–Nagoya 2026?
options: Sheikh Joaan bin Hamad Al Thani
mcqs.explanation: The OCA President was Sheikh Joaan bin Hamad Al Thani. Emperor Naruhito declared the Games open, Rajendra Prasad opened the first Asian Games, and Sujeet Kalkal received the best male athlete award.

mcqs.question: The 46th Chess Olympiad 2026 was hosted in which city and country?
mcqs.explanation: The 46th Chess Olympiad was held in Samarkand, Uzbekistan. Dakar hosted the Youth Olympic Games, while Hanoi hosted IOAA 2026.

mcqs.question: Which country won the gold medal in the Open section of the 46th Chess Olympiad 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Uzbekistan won gold in the Open section. India won silver and Germany won bronze; China won gold in the Women’s section.

mcqs.question: On which date did Harmanpreet Kaur step down as India women’s captain across all formats?
mcqs.explanation: Harmanpreet Kaur stepped down on 6 October 2026 after a BCCI review in Guwahati. The other dates relate to the Chess Olympiad or the Dakar Youth Olympic Games.

mcqs.question: What was India’s medal tally at the 19th International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics 2026?
mcqs.explanation: India won 4 gold medals and 1 silver medal at IOAA 2026, with all 5 Indian participants winning medals. The other combinations alter either the medal colours or the tally.

mcqs.question: The Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games are significant because they are the first what?
options: Youth Olympic Games held in Asia
Olympic multi-sport event held in Africa
Winter Youth Olympic Games held in Africa
mcqs.explanation: Dakar 2026 is the first Olympic multi-sport event in Africa. It is the 4th Summer Youth Olympic Games, not a Commonwealth or Winter Youth Olympic event.

mcqs.question: Which pair is correctly associated with the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games?
options: “One World, One Dream” and a young elephant
“Africa welcomes, Dakar celebrates” and a young lion named Kofi
mcqs.explanation: The slogan is “Africa welcomes, Dakar celebrates” and the mascot is Ayo, a young lion. The other options change either the slogan, mascot, or mascot’s name.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about the Commonwealth Cue Sports Championship 2026 is incorrect?
options: It was held at the Veer Savarkar Sports Complex in Ahmedabad.
Great Britain won the most total medals with 13 medals.
India topped the total medal table with 13 medals.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that Great Britain won the most total medals with 13 medals. India topped the total medal table with 13 medals, while Great Britain won the most gold medals with 4.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about Putul Sonowal’s 2026 achievement is incorrect?
options: She won a bronze medal at the World Bowls Champion of Champions 2026.
She became the first Indian man to medal at this event.
The event was held in Barham, New South Wales, Australia.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement changes “woman” to “man.” Putul Sonowal became the first Indian woman to medal at the World Bowls Champion of Champions.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games:
1. The Games were postponed from 2022 because of COVID.
2. They introduced the first Youth Refugee Olympic Team.
3. Mixed-NOC events were added to the programme.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: the Games were postponed from 2022 because of COVID and featured the first Youth Refugee Olympic Team. Statement 3 is incorrect because mixed-NOC events were dropped.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about the BRICS Traditional and Indigenous Sports Demonstration Games 2026:
1. They were part of India’s BRICS Chairship 2026.
2. They were organised by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports along with the Gujarat Government.
3. They were competitive medal-based games.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The event was a demonstration and therefore non-competitive, making statement 3 incorrect.

mcqs.question:
Match the IOAA 2026 medal category with the associated participant or participants:
List-I
 a. Gold medal
 b. Silver medal
 c. Host city
 d. Coordinating institution in India

List-II
 i. HBCSE
 ii. Hanoi
 iii. Pranjal Dixit, Sumant Gupta, Akshat Srivastava and Arnav Sehrawat
 iv. Harshil Amitkumar Patel
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iii, b-iv, c-ii and d-i. The four named students won gold, Harshil Amitkumar Patel won silver, Hanoi was the host city, and HBCSE coordinated India’s participation.

mcqs.question:
Match the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games feature with the correct detail:
List-I
 a. Slogan
 b. Mascot
 c. Athletes
 d. New sport

List-II
 i. Ayo
 ii. 2,700
 iii. Africa welcomes, Dakar celebrates
 iv. Baseball5
mcqs.explanation: The correct matching is slogan–Africa welcomes, Dakar celebrates; mascot–Ayo; athletes–2,700; and new sport–Baseball5. The other codes interchange these event features.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): India won the Nona Gaprindashvili Trophy at the 46th Chess Olympiad 2026 for the third consecutive time.
Reason (R): The trophy is named after Georgian chess legend Nona Gaprindashvili.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the Assertion and the Reason are true. However, the trophy’s namesake does not explain India’s third consecutive win; it only identifies the person after whom the trophy is named.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Harmanpreet Kaur led India in 211 matches across 51 ODIs, 155 T20Is and 5 Tests.
Statement B: She won 30 ODIs, 92 T20Is and 4 Tests as captain.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Her captaincy record comprised 211 matches, including 51 ODIs, 155 T20Is and 5 Tests, with 30 ODI, 92 T20I and 4 Test wins.

mcqs.question:
Arrange the following BRICS-related milestones in chronological order:
1. South Africa joined BRICS.
2. BRIC was formed.
3. The first BRICS Summit was held at Yekaterinburg.
4. The New Development Bank was established in Shanghai.
5. The first BRICS Games were held in Guangzhou.
mcqs.explanation: The correct order is BRIC in 2006, the first summit in 2009, South Africa’s entry in 2010, the NDB in 2014, and the first BRICS Games in 2017. Therefore, the sequence is 2-3-1-4-5.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements about the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games are correct?
1. They involved 2,700 athletes.
2. They had 25 sports.
3. Baseball5, Skateboarding and Wushu were new sports.
4. Each gender had 1,350 athletes.
mcqs.explanation: All four statements are correct. The Games featured 2,700 athletes, 25 sports, the three listed new sports, and 1,350 athletes of each gender.

mcqs.question: What was the theme of the 38th National Yogasana Championship 2026 held in Imphal?
options: Yoga for Health, Harmony and International Cooperation
Yogasana for Peace, Progress and Global Unity
Yogasana for Health, Harmony and National Unity
Yogasana for Fitness, Discipline and Cultural Unity
mcqs.explanation: The theme was “Yogasana for Health, Harmony and National Unity.” The other options alter the officially stated wording of the theme.

mcqs.question: The 19th World Sudoku and 33rd World Puzzle Championships 2026 were held at which venue during which period?
options: Khuman Lampak Main Indoor Stadium, Imphal, from 2–4 October 2026
Sporting Planet Sports Complex, Belagavi, from 15–18 October 2026
mcqs.explanation: The championships were held at Westin, Rajarhat, Kolkata, from 11–18 October 2026. The other options combine the Kolkata event with the venue or dates of the Imphal and Belagavi events.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding the inaugural AIFF U15 Women’s Youth League is incorrect?
options: It was launched at Khuman Lampak Main Indoor Stadium, Imphal.
It was launched at Sporting Planet Sports Complex, Belagavi, Karnataka.
It featured 16 teams divided into 4 groups.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that the league was launched at Khuman Lampak Main Indoor Stadium, Imphal. Its launch venue was Sporting Planet Sports Complex, Belagavi, Karnataka; Khuman Lampak Main Indoor Stadium hosted the National Yogasana Championship.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about the World Sudoku and World Puzzle Championships:
1. The World Puzzle Federation was established in 1992.
2. The first World Puzzle Championship was held in New York in 1992.
3. The first World Sudoku Championship was held in Lucca, Italy, in 2006.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. The World Puzzle Federation was established in 1992, the first World Puzzle Championship was held in New York in 1992, and the first World Sudoku Championship was held in Lucca, Italy, in 2006.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding the 19th World Sudoku and 33rd World Puzzle Championships 2026.

List-I
(a) Number of rounds
(b) Earlier World Puzzle Championship venue in 2008
(c) Earlier World Puzzle Championship venue in 2017
(d) Puzzle themes

List-II
(i) Bengaluru
(ii) Ramayana and Mahabharata
(iii) Goa
(iv) 38
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iv, b-iii, c-i and d-ii: the event had 38 rounds, earlier World Puzzle Championships were held in Goa in 2008 and Bengaluru in 2017, and the puzzles had Ramayana and Mahabharata themes. The other codes mismatch at least one of these event details.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Manipur won the 38th National Yogasana Championship 2026.
Reason (R): Manipur secured 52 medals, including 22 gold, 16 silver and 14 bronze medals.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the Assertion and the Reason are true, and the medal tally explains Manipur’s championship-winning performance. Manipur won 52 medals—22 gold, 16 silver and 14 bronze—while West Bengal and Vidarbha were the runners-up.

mcqs.question: The 20th Asian Games in 2026 were hosted by which location?
mcqs.explanation: The 20th Asian Games were hosted by Aichi Prefecture and Nagoya in Japan. Doha is the host of the 21st edition in 2030, while Riyadh is the host of the 2034 edition.

mcqs.question: During which period were the 20th Asian Games Aichi–Nagoya 2026 held?
mcqs.explanation: Aichi–Nagoya 2026 was held from 19 September to 4 October 2026. The period 4–11 March 1951 belongs to the first Asian Games in New Delhi; Doha and Riyadh refer to future editions.

mcqs.question: Which description correctly represents participation at Aichi–Nagoya 2026?
options: 45 NOCs plus the OCA Refugee Team, with about 11,000 athletes
45 NOCs without the OCA Refugee Team, with about 11,000 athletes
45 NOCs plus the OCA Refugee Team, with 489 athletes
mcqs.explanation: Participation comprised 45 NOCs and the OCA Refugee Team, with approximately 11,000 athletes. The event was not described as involving 46 nations, and 489 athletes refers to the first Asian Games in 1951.

mcqs.question: Which colour combination was associated with the emblem of Aichi–Nagoya 2026?
options: Green, silver, bronze and red sun
Gold, silver, bronze and red sun
Purple, gold, blue and red sun
Purple, gold, green and red sun
mcqs.explanation: The emblem used purple, gold, green and a red sun. Purple represented the iris of Aichi, gold the Kinshachi of Nagoya Castle, and the red sun was associated with the OCA.

mcqs.question: Which position did Uzbekistan occupy in the medal table of the 20th Asian Games?
mcqs.explanation: Uzbekistan finished 5th with 70 medals. India was 4th, Iran 6th and South Korea 3rd.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding Iran’s medal performance at Aichi–Nagoya 2026 is incorrect?
options: Iran ranked 6th with 19 gold, 18 silver and 15 bronze medals.
Iran won 19 gold, 18 silver and 15 bronze medals.
Iran ranked 6th with 19 gold, 18 silver and 24 bronze medals.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement changes Iran’s bronze-medal count from 15 to 24. Iran ranked 6th and won 19 gold, 18 silver and 15 bronze medals, giving it a total of 52.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about India and Uzbekistan in the Aichi–Nagoya 2026 medal table:
1. India and Uzbekistan both won 21 gold medals.
2. India finished ahead of Uzbekistan because it won more silver medals.
3. Uzbekistan ranked 4th in the medal table.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: both countries won 21 gold medals, but India had 27 silvers against Uzbekistan’s 25. Statement 3 is incorrect because Uzbekistan ranked 5th, while India ranked 4th.

mcqs.question: Who became the first Indian woman to win an individual recurve gold medal at the Asian Games?
mcqs.explanation: Kumkum Anil Mohod became the first Indian woman to win an individual recurve gold at the Asian Games. Neeru Dhanda was associated with shooting, Lovlina Borgohain with boxing and Sujeet Kalkal with freestyle wrestling.

mcqs.question: Which Indian shooter ended the 48-year wait for an Asian Games trap gold medal?
mcqs.explanation: Neeru Dhanda ended India’s 48-year wait for a trap gold medal at the Asian Games. Kumkum Mohod won in archery, Lovlina Borgohain in boxing, and Sujeet Kalkal in freestyle wrestling.

mcqs.question: Which boxer became the second Indian woman after Mary Kom to win an Asian Games boxing gold medal?
mcqs.explanation: Lovlina Borgohain became the second Indian woman after Mary Kom to win an Asian Games boxing gold. Kumkum Mohod represented archery, Neeru Dhanda shooting and Pranavi Urs golf.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding the future Asian Games hosts and IOA athlete awards.

List-I
 a. 2030 Asian Games host
 b. 2034 Asian Games host
 c. Jaspal Rana Memorial Award recipient
 d. Randhir Singh Memorial Award recipient

List-II
 i. Kumkum
 ii. Sujeet Kalkal
 iii. Doha
 iv. Riyadh
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iii, b-iv, c-i and d-ii: Doha hosts the 2030 Games, Riyadh the 2034 Games, Kumkum received the Jaspal Rana Memorial Award and Sujeet Kalkal received the Randhir Singh Memorial Award. The alternatives interchange either the host cities or the award recipients.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Olympic Council of Asia has its headquarters in Kuwait.
Reason (R): The Asian Games Federation was replaced by the OCA in 1981, and the headquarters moved to Kuwait in 1982.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the assertion and the reason are true. The movement of the headquarters to Kuwait in 1982 directly explains why Kuwait is identified as the OCA headquarters.

mcqs.question: By what margin did India defeat Pakistan in the Aichi–Nagoya 2026 Asian Games cricket final?
mcqs.explanation: India defeated Pakistan by 19 runs after scoring 211 and batting first after winning the toss. The figures 21, 24 and 25 appear in the medal details of the Games but were not the cricket-final winning margin.

mcqs.question: Which major achievement was led by Harmanpreet Kaur in 2026?
options: India’s second consecutive Asian Games T20 gold
India’s first Women’s ODI World Cup in 2025
India’s first lawn bowls gold at the Commonwealth Games
India’s gold medal in the Women’s section of the Chess Olympiad
mcqs.explanation: Harmanpreet Kaur led India to its second consecutive Asian Games T20 gold in 2026. India’s first Women’s ODI World Cup came in November 2025, while the other options refer to different sports and events.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about Harmanpreet Kaur:
Statement A: She was the first Indian woman to score a T20I century.
Statement B: She made her international debut in 2010.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is true because Harmanpreet Kaur was the first Indian woman with a T20I century. Statement B is false: her debut was in 2009, not 2010.

mcqs.question:
Match the Harmanpreet Kaur captaincy milestone in List-I with the corresponding detail in List-II.

List-I
 a. First captaincy for India
 b. T20I captaincy
 c. ODI captaincy
 d. All-format captaincy

List-II
 i. 2023
 ii. T20 match against Pakistan at Guangzhou
 iii. 2016
 iv. 2022, after Mithali Raj
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-ii, b-iii, c-iv and d-i. Harmanpreet first captained India in a T20 against Pakistan at Guangzhou, became T20I captain in 2016, ODI captain in 2022 after Mithali Raj, and all-format captain in 2023.

mcqs.question: Who chaired the IOC Coordination Commission for the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games?
mcqs.explanation: Kirsty Coventry chaired the IOC Coordination Commission for the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games. Pierre de Coubertin was the founder of the IOC, while Mithali Raj and Harmanpreet Kaur are associated with Indian cricket.

mcqs.question:
Match the event or institution in List-I with the correct detail in List-II.

List-I
 a. First Summer Youth Olympic Games
 b. Previous Summer Youth Olympic Games before Dakar
 c. First Winter Youth Olympic Games
 d. IOC founding

List-II
 i. Innsbruck, 2012
 ii. Lausanne, 1894
 iii. Singapore, 2010
 iv. Buenos Aires, 2018
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Singapore–2010, Buenos Aires–2018, Innsbruck–2012 and Lausanne–1894. Thus, the code a-iii, b-iv, c-i, d-ii is correct.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about the disciplines at the Commonwealth Cue Sports Championship 2026 is incorrect?
options: Carom was one of the disciplines.
Snooker was one of the disciplines.
English Billiards was one of the disciplines.
Blackball was one of the disciplines.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that Carom was one of the disciplines. The listed disciplines included English Billiards, Snooker, Heyball, 10-Ball Pool and Blackball; Carom was not listed.

mcqs.question: Who is the President of the All India Football Federation (AIFF)?
mcqs.explanation: Kalyan Chaubey is the President of the AIFF. The other options are organisation names, not the person identified as AIFF President.

mcqs.question: Which organisations jointly organised the 38th National Yogasana Championship 2026 in Imphal?
options: Manipur Yoga Society and All India Yoga Culture Federation
Ministry of AYUSH and World Puzzle Federation
All India Yoga Culture Federation and Logic Masters India
mcqs.explanation: The championship was jointly organised by the Manipur Yoga Society and the All India Yoga Culture Federation. Logic Masters India and the World Puzzle Federation are associated with the World Sudoku and World Puzzle Championships, not this Yogasana championship.

mcqs.question: The 38th National Yogasana Championship 2026 also served as trials for which event?
options: The inaugural AIFF U15 Women’s Youth League
mcqs.explanation: The championship served as trials for the 12th World Yogasana Championship to be held in Thailand in 2027. The other options refer either to the national event itself or to unrelated competitions.
